```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

env:
  TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ github.env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
  DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ github.env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up .NET Core SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '6.0'

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Build and test
      run: dotnet build --configuration Release /p:CI=true && dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

    - name: Check if tests passed
      id: check_tests
      uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
      with:
        jobs: build-and-test

    - name: Report results
      if: steps.check_tests.outputs.success == 'true'
      run: echo "All tests passed!"
      env:
        TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ github.env.TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
        DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ github.env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
```
